jobs.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB

We are seeking a Sustainability Analyst to be a core contributor to Live Nation’s sustainability programs. This role delivers high-quality, accurate sustainability data that informs our strategy, supports audits, and gives the business insights help manage costs, reduce risk, and make informed operational decisions. The analyst manages recurring reporting cycles, works proactively with teams across our global markets, and helps improve how we collect and use data. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with initiative, clear communication, and a passion for sustainability.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Data Management and Quality Assurance – 35%

  • Collect, organize, and maintain environmental, operational, and financial data (e.g. energy, waste, and water usage, utility costs and invoices, venue and event activity) from multiple sources.
  • Conduct quality checks to ensure data integrity and accuracy, including reconciling usage data against invoices and financial records.
  • Support the audit process by preparing data summaries, responding to auditor requests, and maintaining documentation.

Analytics and Reporting – 25%

  • Develop and manage Tableau dashboards for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analyze trends in usage, cost, and operational performance to identify savings opportunities and areas for improvement.
  • Assist in preparing presentations, reports, and sustainability communications, translating data into clear takeaways for non-technical audiences.

Project Management – 15%

  • Manage timelines and deliverables for recurring data cycles, including annual reporting, audit, and regional data collection.
  • Coordinate inputs across regional contacts, venues, and internal teams, tracking progress and following up to keep work on schedule.
  • Lead improvement projects from scoping through rollout, such as onboarding new data sources or launching new dashboards.

Stakeholder Engagement – 15%

  • Proactively engage stakeholders (operations, sustainability, finance, and regional teams) on a regular basis to understand their business needs and to confirm that our data, dashboards, and reporting are delivering against them.
  • Serve as a point of contact for regional teams on data requests, guidance, and troubleshooting.
  • Actively participate in team and cross-functional meetings, contributing ideas, sharing updates, and raising issues early.

Process Improvement – 10%

  • Maintain and continuously improve Live Nation's sustainability data platform and data management systems.
  • Partner with internal finance and fintech teams to streamline data workflows, enhance automation, and improve integration between financial, operational, and environmental data.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Demonstrated experience managing, analyzing, and quality-checking data from multiple sources, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to read and interpret utility invoices (electricity, gas, water, waste), including usage, units, rates, and billing periods.
  • Working knowledge of greenhouse gas accounting, including Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions, emission factors, and unit conversions.
  • Proficiency in Excel (lookups, pivot tables, data cleaning, reconciliation) and proficiency in Tableau or a similar data visualization tool.
  • Experience improving data processes, such as standardizing collection templates, streamlining workflows, or supporting automation.
  • Proven ability to manage projects and competing deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to working with stakeholders: comfortable reaching out, asking questions, and contributing in meetings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining data to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a creative, fast-paced, global environment.
  • Preferred: Familiarity with environmental reporting standards and frameworks (e.g. GHG Protocol, CDP, CSRD), and experience supporting a third-party audit or assurance process.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. jobs.description:
PKI JD
Summary:
We are looking for a PKI/CLM Engineer with hands-on experience in ADCS, AWS ACM, and Venafi to design, implement, and manage enterprise PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management services. The role includes certificate automation, policy enforcement, infrastructure and application integration, and ensuring compliance with security and audit standards. Required skills include CRL and OCSP maintenance, AWS Key Vault, cloud and hybrid environments, and PowerShell scripting for automation.
Roles Responsibilities: -
Manage enterprise PKI infrastructure including Root and Issuing Certificate.
Responsibilities:
  • Manage certificate lifecycle activities: issuance, renewal, revocation, rekey, rollover, and retirement.
  • Configure and maintain Offline Root CA, Issuing CAs, certificate templates/profiles, and policy constraints.
  • Manage CRL/OCSP publishing and ensure high availability.
  • Maintain PKI documentation aligned with standards like CP/CPS, operational runbooks, and SOPs.
  • Support audits and compliance requirements, including CAB Forum standards.
  • Manage and monitor PKI/HSM operations end-to-end, including health checks, backups, configurations, and policies.
  • Implement and maintain processes for managing internal and external certificate lifecycles.
  • Monitor certificates for expiration, perform timely renewals, and revoke compromised or obsolete certificates.
  • Possess strong technical expertise in Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS), including OCSP, CRLs, certificate templates, key archival, and NDES/SCEP.
  • Proficient in scripting and automation, especially PowerShell, with the ability to integrate PKI solutions across platforms such as network devices, load balancers, and Windows/Linux environments.
  • Have solid understanding of cryptography and encryption standards, including TLS, X.509, RSA/ECC, CSRs, and secure key management with HSMs and TPMs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based certificate and key management; strong troubleshooting skills; exposure to AWS ACM/PCA, Venafi tools, and relevant security or PKI certifications is advantageous.
  • Assist with enterprise-wide certificate lifecycle tasks, including requests, issuance, renewal, and revocation.
  • Maintain and update inventories of machine identities, including certificates, keys, and service credentials.
  • Assist in identifying orphaned, expired, or misconfigured machine identities.
  • Monitor adherence to governance controls and escalate exceptions or risks.
  • Maintain accurate certificate inventory records, including ownership, purpose, and expiration dates.
  • Identify and report at-risk certificates, including expired, soon-to-expire, weak cryptography, or unknown owners.
  • Assist with certificate issuance requests and validate required information.
  • Demonstrate experience managing enterprise-scale PKI environments across on-premises and cloud platforms, including lifecycle management and automation (e.g., Venafi Trust Protection Platform).
  • Possess strong technical expertise in Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS), including OCSP, CRLs, certificate templates, key archival, and NDES/SCEP.
  • Knowledge of AD, DNS, IAM operations, and CyberArk Privilege Cloud is beneficial.
Required Skills:
  • Microsoft ADCS
  • SCEP
  • AWS PCA
  • Venafi
  • HSM & Encryption
  • PKI & Certificate Management.
  • AD (Good to have)
  • CyberArk (Good to have)

jobs.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a Marketplace Onboarding Manager (or a Marketplace Operations Manager as we like to call it!) to join our Product Team. This individual will report into our Senior Manager, Category Management and will be responsible for the day-to-day operational health of SupplyHouse’s third-party marketplace channel. This role ensures that marketplace performance is continuously monitored, supplier onboarding is executed efficiently, and catalog and listing quality standards are upheld. If you are interested in finding and onboarding new marketplace suppliers and building a pipeline of qualified partners, we want to hear from you!

This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

Role Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $92,940 to $116,175 within a full position range of $92,940 to $139,410 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively research and identify new marketplace supplier candidates across target categories, using competitive analysis, industry resources, and internal category gaps as inputs
  • Conduct initial outreach to prospective suppliers, articulate SupplyHouse’s marketplace value proposition, and manage the early-stage relationship through qualification
  • Coordinate with Category Management to prioritize and schedule new supplier conversations, ensuring alignment with category strategy before advancing candidates
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process for approved suppliers, including agreement coordination, contract administration, data requirements communication, and timeline management
  • Lead technical feed setup and validation for new suppliers—mapping product data, verifying feed accuracy, and resolving data quality issues prior to go-live
  • Train new suppliers on SupplyHouse’s systems, data standards, and operational requirements, ensuring they are set up for long-term success on the platform
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for new suppliers through the onboarding period, troubleshooting issues and maintaining momentum to hit go-live milestones
  • Document onboarding processes and maintain SOPs to ensure consistent, repeatable execution as the supplier base grows
  • Develop and maintain claims, warranty, and returns processes for marketplace suppliers, ensuring clear guidelines and consistent execution across the supplier base
  • Monitor post-launch supplier performance and flag issues with service levels, data quality, or accounting discrepancies for resolution
  • Review weekly feeds for new item suggestions and coordinate with Category Management on additions
  • Research competitor listings to identify opportunities for improvement in content, imagery, and positioning
  • Conduct image audits and data cleanup including attribute and filter updates on new brand
  • Own SOP creation and ongoing maintenance for marketplace operational workflows
  • Test and document new marketplace features and platform capabilities within the supplier dashboards
  • Execute ad hoc operational projects including data cleanup, content audits, and cross-system reconciliation
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Pricing, and Supply Chain teams to resolve issues and support execution
  • Respond to basic marketplace customer inquiries escalated from Customer Service or order fulfillment, and review processed returns to identify trends
  • Reconcile discrepancies between freight and non-freight shipping methods and partner with Product Catalog to update item dimensions as needed
  • Monitor out-of-stock items and communicate gaps to the Merchandising team; support price update processes to maintain alignment between SupplyHouse and supplier pricing

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in in Business, Marketing, Merchandising, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
  • A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in marketplace operations, e-commerce merchandising, or a related field
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales and inventory data and translate findings into action
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working across multiple data systems and reporting tools
  • Experience managing supplier or vendor relationships in an operational capacity
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and shifting priorities
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across cross-functional teams
  • Proven ability to document processes and create SOPs in a structured, repeatable format

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with marketplace platforms (e.g., Amazon, Home Depot, Walmart, or similar) or B2B e-commerce environments
  • Familiarity with product feed management, catalog systems, or MDM tools
  • Experience in plumbing, HVAC, or trade supply distribution is a plus

Why work with us:

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
    • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
    • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
    • Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
    • Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
    • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    • Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 work from home stipend
    • $750 annual professional development budget
    • $25 monthly Grubhub credit
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance –We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
  • We support growth –We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at: !

You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.

English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects, working closely with borrowers, brokers, originators and capital partners to deliver fast, reliable funding.

As its loan volume grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every loan file accurate, complete and moving on time.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Loan Processor & Underwriter to own underwriting, loan file completeness and follow-up on every file through the satisfaction of underwriting conditions.

You will analyze borrower, property and deal risk, collect and verify documentation, manage appraisals, and keep borrowers, brokers and originators informed until each loan is ready to close.

This is not a data entry or conventional mortgage processing role. We are looking for someone with real underwriting and processing experience at a hard money or private lender, who brings strong judgment, persistence and excellent borrower service.

What You'll Do

Underwriting

  • Underwrite business-purpose Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and Ground-Up Construction loans.
  • Analyze credit, borrower experience, liquidity, LTV/LTC, as-is value, ARV, DSCR, construction budgets and exit strategy.
  • Approve loans within delegated guidelines and escalate exceptions.

Loan File Management

  • Collect, verify and organize borrower, guarantor, entity and property documents.
  • Maintain accurate conditions and loan files in the company's loan portal and CRM.

Appraisal Review

  • Order, track and review appraisals, including comparable sales and values.
  • Work with the appraisal management company on corrections or reconsiderations.
  • Promptly advise the originator of any material changes in value or risk.

Follow-Up & Communication

  • Proactively follow up with borrowers, brokers, originators and vendors until all outstanding documents and conditions are resolved.
  • Respond promptly and deliver outstanding service to borrowers, brokers and partners.

Closing Support

  • Coordinate with the closer on underwriting-related items through funding.
  • Correct any underwriting deficiencies identified after closing.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).
  • Practical underwriting and loan processing experience at a comparable lender.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
  • Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.
  • Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.
  • Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

How Success Is Measured

  • Loan files are complete, accurate and organized at every stage.
  • Underwriting decisions are well supported and stay within guidelines.
  • Outstanding conditions are cleared quickly, with minimal reminders.
  • Appraisal issues and material changes are flagged early.
  • Borrowers, brokers and originators receive timely, professional updates.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully Remote Opportunity: Work from anywhere in Latin America with a U.S.-based lender.
  • Competitive Compensation: Earn $1,700 to $2,300 USD per month.
  • Meaningful Responsibility: Own loan files from underwriting through clear to close.
  • Professional Growth: Deepen your experience in U.S. private real estate lending.

Important Notes

  • Candidates must reside in Latin America.
  • Direct experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender is required.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.
  • Excellent English communication skills are essential.
  • Please submit your CV in English and include the lender(s) you worked for, your dates of employment and the loan types you handled.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

  • 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
  • Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
  • Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
  • Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
  • Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
  • Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
  • Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
  • Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949- GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Contract Administration and Management

  • Coordinate the internal and external routing, approval, execution, and distribution of contractual documents to ensure timely completion.

Transaction Confirmations and Compliance

  • Review transaction confirmations for discrepancies and coordinate with Commercial, Risk, Legal, and counterparties to resolve identified issues.
  • Monitor confirmation processing timelines and ensure compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of confirmation activity and support internal controls, audit requirements, and compliance reviews.

Systems and Data Management

  • Create, maintain, and update customer and counterparty account records in contract management databases, Salesforce, and Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) systems.

Reporting and Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve contract administration workflows, data accuracy, and operational efficiency.

jobs.excerpt: JOB BRIEFAs a Product Owner for the Accounting team at GreenSlate, you will define the solutions to problems identified by the Product Manager, partnering with the PM and engineering to translate those problems into clear user stories, requirements, and a sprint-ready backlog for the development team.
jobs.description:
JOB BRIEF

As a Product Owner for the Accounting team at GreenSlate, you will define the solutions to problems identified by the Product Manager, partnering with the PM and engineering to translate those problems into clear user stories, requirements, and a sprint-ready backlog for the development team. You will work daily with developers, QA engineers, and subject matter experts, serving as the primary point of contact for sprint-level questions while building deep expertise in AP entry, payment runs, and bank integrations. Your work will directly shape the accounting experiences that studios, production companies, and content creators rely on, and your ability to turn defined problems into a well-sequenced, sprint-ready backlog will keep our roadmap moving and our platform competitive.

This role is remote within Costa Rica.

WHO WE ARE

GreenSlate is the fastest-growing provider of technology and business solutions for media productions. We provide the most advanced technology for production accounting and entertainment payroll. Our innovative cloud-based platform is evolving the entertainment industry’s back-office by replacing inefficient paper-based processes with digital solutions. The studios, film franchises, independent producers, and content creators we serve benefit from greater efficiencies, better access to data, and cost savings, and they minimize their impact on the environment. GreenSlate offers a full range of payroll, software application, production accounting, tax credit management, ACA compliance & benefits, production insurance, and consulting services. To learn more about the productions we partner with, please visit greenslate.com.

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

  • Own and groom the product backlog for the Accounting domain, writing clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done
  • Partner with the Product Manager and engineering team to define the solution for problems the PM has identified with clients and stakeholders
  • Translate defined problems into sequenced, sprint-ready backlog items in partnership with engineering
  • Partner with subject matter experts and engineering to clarify technical requirements and surface edge cases before work enters a sprint
  • Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint review, clarifying priorities and acceptance criteria and accepting or rejecting completed work alongside the Scrum Master
  • Act as the primary point of contact for developers and QA engineers on questions about requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria during the sprint
  • Write and maintain detailed specifications covering AP entry, payment runs, bank integrations, and related accounting workflows
  • Validate completed work against acceptance criteria before client-facing release
  • Flag scope, timeline, or solution trade-offs to the Product Manager as they arise during sprint execution
  • Communicate sprint progress, scope changes, and release timing to internal stakeholders and, as needed, clients
  • Own backlog items post-release, prioritizing enhancements and bug fixes in partnership with the Product Manager

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in product, entertainment finance, or production accounting
  • Background in accounting or entertainment finance is welcome alongside, or in place of, traditional product experience
  • Experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a backlog in a tool such as Jira
  • Comfortable owning solution design in partnership with a Product Manager and engineering, translating defined problems into a dev-ready backlog
  • Strong understanding of accounting workflows and terminology, or a demonstrated ability to learn them quickly
  • An excellent communicator who can translate technical and financial complexity for a range of stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through from requirement to release
  • Customer-oriented and focused on quality customer experiences
  • A skilled collaborator, working with people at all levels of the company
  • You are interested in developing an in-depth knowledge of the production accounting and payroll industry

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US (Costa Rica)

  • Compensation that reflects your value: Competitive salary packages tailored to your experience with opportunities for regular reviews and raises
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Benefits that go beyond the basics, including private medical and life insurance, psychological support, English program, wellness discounts and perks through the Holisticly platform.
  • Full-Time Remote Flexibility: Enjoy working remotely with all the tools and support needed to stay connected and productive
  • Impactful Work: Be part of projects that make a difference in the entertainment industry, with a direct influence on shaping our future and making tangible change
  • A Thriving, Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values open communication and creativity. Quality, Urgency, Innovation, Service, and Collaboration drive everything we do backed by access to leading AI tools so you can work smarter, not harder

jobs.description:
TrueTandem is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Azure Infrastructure Cloud Engineer to support the delivery of enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure and platform services for a member of the Intelligence Community (IC). This role is ideal for a seasoned cloud professional with expertise in Azure infrastructure, automation, security, governance, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) who thrives in mission-driven environments.

The successful candidate will join a team responsible for designing, deploying, securing, and sustaining cloud platforms that support critical mission and business applications. Solutions are engineered in accordance with approved reference architectures, federal security requirements, organizational policies, and cloud engineering best practices.

The environment leverages Azure-native services, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Terraform, Bicep, and Azure DevOps to deliver secure, scalable, and repeatable cloud capabilities. The team emphasizes automation, policy-driven governance, continuous compliance validation, operational excellence, and efficient platform management to accelerate cloud adoption while maintaining security and regulatory requirements.

As a Senior Azure Infrastructure Cloud Engineer, you will help build and maintain the core Azure infrastructure foundation that enables mission and business workloads across the enterprise. Working within a cross-functional team of architects, engineers, developers, and cybersecurity professionals, you will design, implement, and support Azure governance frameworks, subscriptions, management groups, virtual networking, storage services, Key Vault, monitoring solutions, security controls, identity integration, workload migrations, and operational sustainment activities.

The ideal candidate possesses hands-on experience supporting complex federal cloud environments and demonstrates the ability to troubleshoot and resolve challenging infrastructure issues while balancing security, performance, reliability, and scalability requirements. Success in this role requires a strong commitment to automation, continuous improvement, and delivering secure, resilient cloud solutions that support evolving mission needs.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to some of the most critical cloud modernization initiatives within the federal government while working with leading technologies and a highly collaborative engineering team.

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform to deliver secure, scalable, and repeatable Azure infrastructure deployments.
  • Build, enhance, and support automated CI/CD pipelines within Azure DevOps to streamline infrastructure provisioning, application delivery, and operational deployments.
  • Architect, deploy, and sustain Azure infrastructure services in alignment with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well-Architected Framework, and organizational standards.
  • Implement and administer Azure governance capabilities, including Management Groups, Subscriptions, Resource Groups, Policies, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), to enforce security, compliance, and operational consistency.
  • Configure and manage Azure Key Vault to safeguard secrets, certificates, encryption keys, and application credentials.
  • Design, deploy, and support Azure storage solutions while implementing data protection, backup, recovery, retention, and lifecycle management strategies.
  • Architect and maintain enterprise networking solutions, including Virtual WAN, Virtual Networks (VNets), Network Security Groups (NSGs), private connectivity, DNS, and hybrid cloud integrations.
  • Implement enterprise monitoring and observability solutions using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerts, dashboards, and automated response capabilities.
  • Support the migration, modernization, and optimization of applications and workloads into Azure cloud environments.
  • Integrate security controls and compliance requirements throughout the infrastructure lifecycle in accordance with Zero Trust principles, TIC 3.0 guidance, NIST frameworks, and federal security baselines.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, identity, performance, and security issues across cloud environments to ensure platform reliability and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with architects, developers, cybersecurity teams, and stakeholders to design, implement, and continuously improve secure, resilient, and mission-focused cloud solutions.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of reusable infrastructure modules, engineering standards, reference architectures, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in platform sustainment activities, capacity planning, incident response, problem management, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, architecture diagrams, and audit artifacts to support operational, security, and compliance requirements.

Required Skills

  • Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility. Higher level clearance is an asset.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting Tier II Azure environments or 3+ years supporting Tier III enterprise Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and sustaining Azure enterprise landing zones and core infrastructure services aligned with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and cloud engineering best practices.
  • Deep expertise in Azure governance and platform services, including Management Groups, Subscriptions, Resource Groups, Azure Policy, RBAC, Key Vault, Storage, and networking services.
  • Hands-on experience designing and supporting Azure networking solutions, including Virtual WAN, Virtual Networks (VNets), Network Security Groups (NSGs), private connectivity, routing, and hybrid-cloud architectures.
  • Experience administering and supporting Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments, including host pools, image management, FSLogix profiles, session hosts, and enterprise user support.
  • Strong understanding of Azure security, monitoring, and operational practices, including Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerts, diagnostics, and security controls.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation to streamline cloud operations, configuration management, and administrative tasks.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies and tools such as Terraform to deploy and manage Azure resources in a repeatable and auditable manner.
  • Knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks, including Zero Trust Architecture, NIST standards, TIC 3.0, and government cloud security requirements.
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure, networking, identity, performance, and security issues across enterprise Azure environments.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to create technical documentation, operational procedures, and architecture artifacts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams consisting of cloud engineers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, developers, and mission stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

  • Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700), or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
  • Experience supporting IC, DoD, or other classified federal cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of Bicep, ARM templates, or additional IaC frameworks.
  • Experience supporting cloud migration, modernization, and application transformation initiatives.
  • Experience with Power Platform integration in Azure environments.
  • Familiarity with AOAI embedded features and Copilot capabilities.
  • Knowledge of workload/application migrations and hybrid cloud strategies.
  • Understanding of Microsoft licensing models and subscription management.

jobs.title: Senior SAP Business One Berater (m/w/d): Cloud-Migration & Zukunftsarchitektur
jobs.excerpt: Die Cloudiax AG ist ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen mit Fokus auf cloudbasierte Lösungen und digitale Transformation.
jobs.description:
Die Cloudiax AG ist ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen mit Fokus auf cloudbasierte Lösungen und digitale Transformation. Seit über 10 Jahren unterstützt das Unternehmen Organisationen dabei, ihre IT-Infrastruktur zu modernisieren und digitale Geschäftsmodelle erfolgreich umzusetzen. Mit einem internationalen Team und höchsten Standards in Sicherheit, Verfügbarkeit und Performance steht Cloudiax für zukunftsfähige Cloud-Lösungen „made in Germany“. Als einer der führenden Anbieter im Hosting von SAP Business One in der Cloud betreibt das Unternehmen zudem eigene KI-Server für innovative Anwendung.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir dich als SAP Business One Berater (m/w/d) in Vollzeit. Ab sofort und Remote, mit gelegentlicher Reisebereitschaft.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Ein großer Teil unserer Partnerkunden betreibt SAP Business One noch auf Microsoft SQL Server und On-Premise. Deshalb startest du bei Cloudiax zunächst mit der internen Migration unserer eigenen Business-One-Landschaft auf SAP HANA. Gemeinsam mit unserem Team schaffst du die Grundlage für unsere zukünftige Plattform und sammelst wertvolle Erfahrungen für spätere Kundenprojekte.

Anschließend begleitest du Partner und Endkunden bei der sicheren Migration ihrer Business-One-Systeme in die Cloudiax Cloud. Du entwickelst nachvollziehbare Migrationsstrategien, nimmst Kunden die Unsicherheit und bewertest bestehendes Customizing, Add-ons und Prozesse.

Gleichzeitig gestaltest du die zukünftige Business-One-Architektur aktiv mit – Richtung Version 11, Web Client First, HANA, Linux/Kubernetes und KI-gestützte Prozessautomatisierung über AXeLANT.

Du bist also nicht nur Berater für Migrationsprojekte, sondern Mitgestalter der nächsten Generation von SAP Business One bei Cloudiax.

**Deine Aufgaben

**

1. Interne HANA-Migration

  • Du übernimmst federführend die fachliche Begleitung der Migration unserer eigenen SAP-Business-One-Umgebung von Microsoft SQL Server auf SAP HANA.
  • Du arbeitest dabei eng mit Development und DevOps zusammen und entwickelst Best Practices, die später auch bei Kundenprojekten eingesetzt werden.
  • Du dokumentierst Erfahrungen, Stolpersteine und bewährte Vorgehensweisen und schaffst damit die Grundlage für zukünftige Kundenmigrationen.

2. Kundenberatung & Migration

  • Du begleitest Partner und Endkunden bei der Migration bestehender On-Premise-B1-Systeme in die Cloudiax Cloud
  • Du analysierst gewachsene Systemlandschaften (Customizing, Individualentwicklungen, Add-Ons) und bewertest ehrlich, was migrationsfähig ist, was angepasst werden muss und wo Risiken liegen
  • Du entwickelst konkrete, nachvollziehbare Migrationsfahrpläne, die Kunden Sicherheit geben statt Bauchschmerzen
  • Du bist technischer und prozessualer Ansprechpartner für Partner und Kunden während der Migration
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Partnermanagement und Entwicklung zusammen, um Migrationsprojekte frühzeitig zu identifizieren und zu begleiten

3. Konzeption & Zielarchitektur

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit an der Zielarchitektur für Business One Version 11 (Linux, Kubernetes, Web Client) bei Cloudiax
  • Du bringst dein Prozesswissen ein, um zu identifizieren: Welche Business-One-Prozesse und -Schwachstellen lassen sich sinnvoll über Extensions oder über AXeLANT, unsere KI-Automatisierungsplattform, neu und besser lösen?
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Innovations- und Produktteam an der Weiterentwicklung von AXeLANT zusammen und bist interessiert daran, Add-Ons und Lösungen in Form von Agenten zu denken.
  • Du bewertest den Service Layer als API-Fundament für neue Erweiterungen und Integrationen
  • Du baust internes Wissen zu gängigen B1-Add-Ons auf, inklusive einer ehrlichen Einschätzung, welche davon in der neuen Architektur ersetzt oder abgelöst werden können
  • Du musst das nicht allein stemmen: Bei der technischen Umsetzung stehen dir Kollegen aus unserem Development- und DevOps-Team zur Seite. Deine Stärke sind Fachwissen, Konzeption und Kundennähe, nicht das Alleine-Programmieren

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als SAP Business One Berater, idealerweise mit Migrations-, Rollout- oder Systemwechselprojekten
  • Sehr gutes Prozesswissen in SAP Business One sowie Erfahrung mit gängigen Komponenten wie dem Service-Layer und externen Add-ons
  • Du kennst die Business-One-Welt in- und auswendig, sprichst die Sprache der Kunden und kannst Chancen, Grenzen und Risiken realistisch einschätzen
  • Du interessierst dich für moderne Business-One-Technologien wie Web Client, Cloud, Linux/Kubernetes und KI und möchtest die zukünftige Architektur aktiv mitgestalten
  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse, denkst in Lösungen und möchtest gewachsene Workarounds durch moderne Ansätze und Automatisierung mit AXeLANT ablösen
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und erklärst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich, sodass Kunden Vertrauen gewinnen und Veränderungen mitgehen
  • Du arbeitest konzeptionell und verbindest die Anforderungen von heute mit der Zielarchitektur von morgen
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Partnern und Kunde

Benefits

  • 100% Remote – arbeite, wo du am produktivsten bist
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne starre Kernzeiten
  • Automatische, KPI-basierte Gehaltsentwicklungen + attraktive Jahresboni
  • 30+ Tage Erholungsurlaub
  • Voll ausgestatteter Premium-Homeoffice-Arbeitsplatz
  • Firmen-(e)Bike, betriebliche Kranken-Zusatzversicherung & weitere Corporate Benefits
  • Internationales Umfeld bei einem weltweit führenden Cloud-Provider im SAP-Business-One-Bereich
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

Wenn wir Dein Interesse geweckt haben und Du Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte sein möchtest, steht Dir unsere HR Business Partnerin Leonie Neumann für eine erste Kontaktaufnahme und weiterführende Informationen gerne zur Verfügung.

jobs.description:
Pulmovant is a Roivant-backed clinical-stage biotechnology company committed to transforming the lives of patients with pulmonary diseases. Pulmovant’s first investigational candidate, mosliciguat, is designed to provide a novel, once-daily, inhaled treatment option for patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD). Mosliciguat is a potential first-in-class soluble guanylate cyclase activator with a differentiated mechanism of action currently being evaluated in the Phase 3 PHrontier global clinical trial in PH-ILD, but with potential broad applicability across the PH and ILD disease landscape. 

Pulmovant recently announced positive results from its Phase 2 PHocus study evaluating mosliciguat for the treatment of pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), a progressive and life-threatening condition with significant unmet medical needs for patients. PHocus met both primary and secondary endpoints including the highest ever reported pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) reduction in any randomized controlled PH trial. The robust results, in conjunction with mosliciguat’s once-daily, inhaled administration and potential first-in-class sGC activator profile, strongly position it as a potential single agent treatment and combination therapy for patients with PH-ILD.  These data represent a significant advancement in a devastating disease that affects ~200,000 patients with no or very limited treatment options. A Phase 3 trial is currently underway. More details can be found in the press release here.

As part of the Roivant family of companies, Pulmovant leverages the power of collaboration and innovation to drive progress.

For more information, please visit .

About Roivant:

Roivant (Nasdaq: ROIV) is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company that aims to improve the lives of patients by accelerating the development and commercialization of medicines that matter. Roivant’s pipeline includes LISRAYA™ (brepocitinib), a potent small molecule inhibitor of JAK1 and TYK2 FDA-approved for the treatment of dermatomyositis in adult patients and also in late-stage development for the treatment of non-infectious uveitis, cutaneous sarcoidosis and lichen planopilaris; IMVT-1402, a fully human monoclonal antibody targeting FcRn in development across several IgG-mediated autoimmune indications; and mosliciguat, an inhaled sGC activator in development for pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease. We advance our pipeline by creating nimble subsidiaries or “Vants” to develop and commercialize our medicines and technologies. For more information, visit .

Position: Manager, CMC Quality

Summary:

The Manager, CMC Quality will support quality oversight of Pulmovant's vendors to ensure that drug substance, drug product, and finished product are manufactured, tested, released, and distributed in compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs). Reporting to the Director, CMC Quality, this individual contributor role will focus on batch record review and product disposition for Pulmovant's global clinical development program. The role requires someone who thrives in a small-company environment and is comfortable being hands-on, with a practical, detail-oriented approach to release decisions and quality systems at external partners.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead batch record review and clinical lot disposition for drug substance, drug product (inhaled), and clinical packaging and labeling, ensuring product is released in compliance with Pulmovant procedures, cGMPs, and applicable regional requirements.
  • Support QP certification and release activities at contract manufacturing partners for ex-US clinical trials, including preparation of batch documentation packages and coordination of release timelines with CMOs, Supply Chain, and Clinical Operations.
  • Review executed batch records, certificates of analysis, and associated testing data for accuracy, completeness, and conformance to master batch records, specifications, and registered/IND/IMPD commitments; drive timely resolution of documentation errors and gaps.
  • Oversee GMP Quality Systems activities at external partners, including deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, and OOS/OOT investigations, ensuring timely and compliant execution and closure and assessing their impact on batch disposition.
  • Maintain disposition and batch review tracking and metrics (e.g., right-first-time, review cycle time, deviation trends) and communicate product quality performance and release status to Quality and cross-functional teams.
  • Partner with CMC, Supply Chain, and Regulatory Affairs to assess product quality impact of events, identify product-specific quality and compliance risks, and support risk-mitigation plans.
  • Review and provide quality input on master batch records, specifications, test methods, protocols, reports, and SOPs; support the drafting and maintenance of Pulmovant batch release and disposition procedures.
  • Support regulatory inspection preparation and ongoing inspection readiness activities, including batch record and disposition documentation.

Education and Experience

  • BA/BS degree in Chemistry, Biology, or Life Sciences with at least 4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including GMP quality assurance experience.

Essential Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated knowledge of Quality Systems and cGMP within a regulated environment.
  • Hands-on experience with batch record review and product disposition/release for clinical or commercial pharmaceutical products.
  • Working knowledge of Good Distribution Practices and of ex-US clinical supply requirements (e.g., EU Annex 13, QP release) preferred.
  • Experience with deviation, investigation, CAPA, change control, and OOS/OOT processes at CMOs.
  • Familiarity with inhaled drug product, drug substance, and/or clinical packaging and labeling operations preferred.
  • Auditing experience preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical skills, with the ability to apply risk-based decision making to disposition issues.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build rapport across functions and with external partners.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills; able to manage multiple concurrent batches and tight release timelines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present findings and recommendations in a clear, concise format.
  • Experience in fast-paced, start-up environments preferred - able to work comfortably under pressure, frequently changing priorities, and tight deadlines.

jobs.description:
NeoCloud BD Pursuit Specialist / Account Executive

Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Reports to the Head of NeoCloud Sales

Salary range: $171,000 - $192,000, plus variable pay and RSUs. Target OTE $285,000 - $320,000, 60:40 base to variable.

How We Got Here

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

  • B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
  • B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
  • B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
  • Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

NeoClouds are GPU-rich, AI-native infrastructure providers, and they need fast, affordable, S3-compatible storage at scale. Backblaze is the high-performance capacity storage layer for AI. You will win these accounts.

This is a new-logo role. You will own a named set of NeoClouds from the top 80 worldwide and pursue them from first meeting to signed contract.

This is not an inbound role. If you want a defined territory and a queue of warm leads, it isn't the right fit. If your instinct is to pick an account, find the engineer who feels the storage cost first, and work up to the CXO, keep reading.

What You Will Do

  • Pursue named accounts. Build a pursuit plan for each account. Map the buying group from infrastructure engineers to the CXO, and build relationships across it.
  • Run discovery. Learn how each NeoCloud runs its stack, where storage costs and performance limit it, and how Backblaze fits. Work with the Sales Engineer and Field CTO on technical validation and proof-of-concept testing.
  • Choose the route. Your motion is Sell-To. Decide with your manager when an account also calls for Sell-With, which Strategic Partnerships runs with the Head of NeoCloud Sales. When a partner such as NVIDIA, Super Micro, Weka, VAST, or AMD helps win the account, bring in Strategic Partnerships.
  • Shape the deal. Work with your manager and legal on multi-year commitments, SLAs, and revenue share when Backblaze runs behind a NeoCloud's storage service.
  • Sell inside Backblaze. Pull Cloud Operations and Engineering into the integration early. Their time is as scarce as your buyer's, and you will earn it.
  • Line up executive sponsors. Secure a Backblaze executive sponsor and a customer executive sponsor on every priority account.
  • Hand off and expand. Bring in the strategic account manager in Customer Success as customers go live, and stay in the account as it grows.
  • Keep the forecast honest. Maintain accurate pipeline, next steps, and close dates in the CRM.

What We Are Looking For

  • Infrastructure sales expertise, with a record of closing complex, multi-year deals in storage, cloud, compute, networking, or data center infrastructure
  • Technical fluency. You run most technical conversations with infrastructure engineers and architects about GPU clusters, networking, and storage yourself, and earn their trust. The Sales Engineer owns deeper validation and proofs of concept
  • Executive presence. You have built VP, SVP, and CTO relationships and can lead those meetings
  • Hunter drive. You open doors in accounts that do not know you yet, and you stay with a long pursuit
  • Seller of record. You have carried a quota and closed deals with your name on them
  • Deal structure experience. You have negotiated SLA, IP, and revenue-share terms on deals you closed, not just understood them
  • Team play. You work well with sales engineers, partner teams, and operations teams to land one account

Also True of the Right Person

  • Existing relationships with NeoCloud technical or executive leaders
  • Experience with OEM, ISV, or co-sell motions
  • Familiarity with S3-compatible object storage, data egress economics, and AI/ML data pipelines

This Is Not the Role for You If

  • You want a defined territory or an inbound queue rather than named accounts you have to open
  • You prefer a short sales cycle to a long pursuit
  • You hand technical questions to someone else and wait for the answer
  • You want to bring a SaaS motion here unchanged
  • You work accounts alone rather than with sales engineering, partners, and operations

How We Will Interview

We will ask you to walk us through a pursuit you ran from first meeting to signed contract, including a long one that stalled and how you kept it moving. We will ask how you earned an infrastructure engineer's trust. We will ask for your own view of how you would approach this role. You will hold cross-functional conversations with the Sales Engineer and the Field CTO, because you will pursue accounts with them. And you will go through a panel, so we can see how you work.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity package
  • Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) with matching
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook to use for work, plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • A collaborative and transparent culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

Pay Transparency and Equal Opportunity

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

Compensation for this role is $171,000 - $192,000, plus variable pay and RSUs. Target OTE $285,000 - $320,000, 60:40 base to variable.

We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive

  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Head of Studio to lead our Traditional Studio, GenAI Studio, and Marketing Production functions, reporting to the Global CCO. This senior leadership role blends studio leadership, executive creative and production oversight, post-production expertise, and GenAI innovation, setting creative and technical standards, pioneering hybrid traditional and AI-powered workflows, shaping pricing and commercial models, and partnering with senior client stakeholders and platform partners to deliver content at scale.

Role responsibilities

Studio Leadership

  • Own output and performance accountability for Traditional Studio, GenAI Studio, and Marketing Production
  • Directly manage Motion/Editorial Leads, GenAI Lead, and Associate Director of Studio; set creative and technical standards across all three studios
  • Report studio performance, capacity, and roadmap to the Global CCO

Traditional Studio (Physical Production, Motion Graphics & Content at Scale)

  • Own all live-action shoot execution across the studio's work
  • Own motion graphics, configurators, website motion, social, and at-scale content production
  • Partner with account-aligned Creative Directors to shape ideas based on the brief, bringing a deep TVC production background to the collaboration
  • Direct video productions from concept to final cut
  • Serve as final creative eye and technical supervisor over post-production (owned day-to-day by Motion/Editorial Leads) - grounded in a VFX compositing, color, and technical filmmaking background
  • Build/maintain custom tooling (code) for scaled content production and complex VFX pipelines
  • Partner with talent agencies, production studios, and freelancers to build ideal team composition for each shoot

GenAI Studio & Future of Content

  • Lead the GenAI Lead and GenAI Studio's offering: architect multi-model chains for high-fidelity, production-grade, art-directable imagery base around traditional production creative decision making
  • Drive the studio's future-of-content agenda: pioneer and champion hybrid workflows that blend traditional production and GenAI output

Marketing Production

  • Provide creative oversight on brand films and case-study films, shaping narrative and visual flow to elevate brand profile and ensure consistently crisp storytelling

Executive Production & Commercial Models

  • Serve as Executive Producer partnering with the Associate Director of Studio on pricing models and commercial structures for studio work

Talent Operations

  • Partner with Americas Ops to optimize talent utilization across client-billable and funded internal work
  • Support contractor hiring and full time hiring and vetting across the studio functions

Presales, Account Growth & Partnerships

  • Serve as senior technical/creative voice in pitches, presenting GenAI and content capabilities directly to CMOs and senior client stakeholders
  • Regularly support account growth conversations across accounts as a content subject-matter expert, helping qualify content deals in a sales capacity
  • Partner with Google and Microsoft platform teams on custom platforms to drive consumption via the content supply chain

Must have qualifications

• 15+ years in TVC/commercial production spanning creative direction, directing, and post
• Strong, demonstrable portfolio spanning all key craft categories within the studio (creative/concept, directing, post/VFX/motion/color, GenAI-driven content) — an "M-shaped" talent profile rather than single-discipline depth
• VFX compositing, color, and technical filmmaking background
• Track record leading multiple production functions/teams, not just individual delivery
• Proven GenAI/multi-model pipeline expertise with fidelity and consistency control
• Track record introducing new workflows/methodologies to a production team (change management, not just tool adoption)
• Comfortable presenting to C-suite/CMO audiences
• Experience qualifying/scoping deals as a subject-matter expert in a sales-support capacity
• Coding/scripting applied to production tooling
• Experience with resource/utilization planning and talent-network management across billable and internal work
• Pricing/commercial model development for production services

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

Your application process

We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.
