Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Principal Software Engineer at Coupa:

We're looking for someone who's rebuilt a production system while it was running. CSP (Coupa Supplier Platform) serves millions of supplier companies—it's where they find work, receive orders, issue invoices, and get paid. The platform started as a Rails monolith. It works, but it needs to evolve. More traffic, more features, multi-cloud deployment, higher availability requirements.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering. CSP operates as a nimble team outside the larger engineering org, moving fast and pioneering approaches that demonstrate what's possible. You'll work with Ruby on Rails, Golang, Java—and introduce whatever else the architecture needs.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the architectural evolution. Traffic is growing, functionality is expanding, robustness matters more than ever. You'll define what changes, in what order, and why.
  • Set the patterns: API design, microservice boundaries, deployment pipelines, monitoring, reliability. Make them real, not theoretical.
  • Mentor engineers. Guide decisions. Review architecture and code. Build the kind of team that ships ambitious work.
  • Join the Architectural Steering Group. Share what you learn with Principal Engineers across Coupa. Import what works elsewhere.
  • Partner with SRE on cloud-native infrastructure: CI/CD, containers, infrastructure-as-code, multi-cloud capabilities.
  • Own security, multi-tenancy isolation, data governance, and compliance across all regions.
  • Work with product, design, and business teams to turn supplier workflows into systems that scale.

What You Will Bring to Coupa

  • 15+ years building B2B SaaS at scale. You've held leadership and architectural roles where your decisions stuck around.
  • Real experience evolving legacy systems into microservices—in production, with users depending on uptime.
  • Deep knowledge of API-driven services, multi-tenant architectures, and B2B integration patterns that handle millions of users.
  • Solid foundation in modern deployment: CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, working with cloud providers like AWS or GCP.
  • Comfort across technology stacks (Rails, Golang, Java) and the judgment to pick tools that solve problems, not resume lines.
  • Track record mentoring teams—providing direction without micromanaging, staying technical without bottlenecking.
  • Problem-solving skills that balance scale, performance, technical debt, and shipping features. You know the trade-offs because you've lived them.
  • Communication skills that work across engineering, product, and business. You build consensus without watering down hard truths.

The person in this role will be responsible for the development and execution of strategies to activate brands and the value chain for coated paper articles and flexible packaging used in the food service and consumer packaged goods (CPG) industries. This role requires up to 30% travel.

  • Earnings: Drive variable margin gains by closing new business initiatives.

jobs.excerpt: At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise.
jobs.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

As a Principal Sales Engineer, you will have a significant impact on the success of each sales presentation in which you participate and will share in its financial rewards. In this key position, you will contribute directly to the bottom-line health of the company.

As a Principal Sales Engineer, you will lead the technical sales strategy, deliver advanced product demonstrations, and guide customers through complex solution architectures. You’ll mentor other sales engineers, collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to align customer feedback with roadmap priorities, and support executive-level discussions. Your deep understanding of our technology, market landscape, and customer challenges will allow you to design and advocate for customer-tailored solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Additionally, you will proactively resolve pre-sales technical challenges and act as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and customer stakeholders throughout the buying journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete mastery of all ExtraHop demo narratives
  • Sufficiently versatile with the ExtraHop platform to conduct any ad-hoc demo upon request
  • Key stakeholder in our demo creation/update process
  • Maintain documents that are key to the SE workflow; deployment guidelines, POC best-practices, compelling use-cases, etc.
  • Guide and mentor new ExtraHop SEs
  • Recognized throughout the company as an expert in specific technologies/domains
  • Recognized by peer SEs for their significant contributions that have benefited the broader SE community
  • Ability to create and deliver public speaking sessions, blog posts, social media activity and analyst interactions.
  • Interface with Product Management to relay market demands from prospects/customers and play a role in shaping the product roadmap
  • Play an active role in the continuous refinement of our POC process; scoping questions/materials, output documents and best practices for aligning POC results to compelling business value
  • Become an acknowledged expert in one or more competitive products and lend assistance to other SEs that encounter that vendor
  • Identify new areas of opportunity/revenue growth based on your customer/industry relationships and knowledge of the verticals we support
  • Expert SFDC user very familiar with our use of the tool and capable of suggesting improvements to our SFDC workflows that would benefit the SE organization
  • Considers the business at-large when advocating for product/process changes and is able to assess the situation from the perspective of other organizations within the company
  • Actively drives changes to SE/company processes; comes up with an idea, vets it with peers/leadership, fleshes it out and leads the execution in concert with other internal stakeholders
  • Expert-level understanding of the sales process; incorporates business requirements into the demo narrative, ensures POC outcomes are aligned with business impact, able to quickly/accurate qualify an opportunity
  • Mastery of solution design; capable of translating customer input into a solution architecture that seamlessly aligns with the business proposal being developed by the RSM

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 10-14 years selling Cloud and Cyber Security technology into large Enterprises with direct AWS, Azure or GCP experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or related area or demonstration of equivalent knowledge
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience working directly with cloud concepts
  • Complex and strategic selling experience required

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of enterprise-architecture concepts, risk management, and excellent working knowledge of key protocols across Layers 2-7 (e.g., TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, SSL/TLS, etc.).
  • Expert level understanding of enterprise information technologies across the full OSI stack, cloud concepts (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • In-depth knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering Concepts
  • Familiarity with automation and infrastructure as code technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Cloud Formation
  • Conducts highly complex work critical to the organisation
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and leadership skills, acts as a role model and a mentor for other sales engineers.
  • Excellent communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills with the ability to interact and address Senior executive and technical audiences
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and have an ongoing desire to stay current with the latest technologies
  • Works without supervision with extensive latitude for independent judgement.
  • Strong problem-solving skills: must be capable of accurately assessing needs, maintaining a calm business demeanor, and taking quick action to resolve issues
  • Works cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders
  • Works well in fast-paced, high-stress environments.
  • Has predictable, reliable attendance.

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $190,000 CAD. This is a commission-eligible position with a 70/30 pay mix, for total target compensation of approximately $234,000 to $247,000 CAD at plan. Actual commission earnings are based on individual performance against quota.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
  • Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
  • Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
  • Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
  • Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
  • Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
  • Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
  • Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
  • Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.

Supervisory / Management Responsibilities

This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewWe are designing the grid of the future!  ENER-i is a cutting-edge software solution from Electric Power Engineers (EPE) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization.
jobs.description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

ENER-i is a cutting-edge software solution from Electric Power Engineers (EPE) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization. Backed by the collective expertise of EPE, ENER-i brings decades of industry engineering experience to the world of cloud-based, enterprise computing software. ENER-i's goal is to create a shared, secure, curated data platform, providing engineers with the means for intelligent data aggregation, insightful engineering analytics engines, GIS, network connectivity models, machine learning & augmented intelligence. Our mission is to close the gap between planning and operations; transmission and distribution and merge the interests of the government, the public, and private industry.

Responsibilities

Join us in leading the change!

The Software Power Systems Engineer will work as a core member of the ENER-i software development team, owning the power systems engineering behind the platform's analysis modules from algorithm design through production code. This involves designing, developing, testing, and validating scalable engines and workflows for distribution system analysis. Such analyses include but are not limited to: quasi-static time-series (QSTS) unbalanced power flow, hosting capacity and DER interconnection screening, automated thermal and voltage violation mitigation, value of DER and non-wires alternatives analysis, flexible interconnection, reliability analyses, resiliency analyses, and DERMS operational planning, and long-term capacity and investment planning.

The level of the role (Engineer III, Senior, Principal, or Senior Principal) will be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience. Principal-level engineers are expected to set technical direction for the platform's powerflow analysis architecture and lead cross-team initiatives.

The Software Power Systems Engineer will also engage with the ENER-i product, engineering, and client delivery teams for tasks such as:

  • Distribution model conversion, validation, and onboarding (e.g., CYME, Synergi, WindMil, OpenDSS)
  • Translating utility planning practices and criteria into technical specifications
  • Technical design reviews and architecture decisions for analysis engines
  • Validation of platform results against commercial tools and field data
  • Performance benchmarking and scale testing on utility-sized models
  • Client technical workshops, demonstrations, and user training
  • Perform and deliver ENER-i based distribution planning studies when needed

How you can make an impact:

  • Design and implement production-grade Python libraries and services for distribution analysis, power flow orchestration, and optimization within the ENER-i platform.
  • Scale simulations across thousands of feeders and full-year time-series through parallelization, cloud batch processing, and performance tuning – including compiled languages (e.g., Rust, C++) where it matters.
  • Build and maintain distribution data models and model converters that bring utility network models (CYME, Synergi, WindMil, OpenDSS, GIS) into a common, validated representation.
  • Develop algorithms for automated mitigation, hosting capacity, DER valuation, and grid planning using optimization (LP/MILP), heuristics, and data-driven methods.
  • Establish test automation, validation suites, and engineering benchmarks that keep platform results accurate and trustworthy.
  • Serve as a distribution subject matter expert to developers, product owners, and product managers; review requirements and user stories for engineering correctness.
  • Propose and prototype new ENER-i modules and help shape the technical roadmap with product management.
  • Mentor engineers and developers, contribute to code and design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team.
  • Represent EPE through publications, open-source contributions, and industry working groups where appropriate.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a power systems focus, or a Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years (Engineer III) or 7+ years (Principal) of combined experience in distribution system analysis and software development; national laboratory, research, utility, and vendor experience all count.
  • Expert understanding of three-phase, unbalanced distribution systems, power flow formulations, and distribution planning practices.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one distribution modeling tool (e.g., OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi, WindMil, or GridLAB-D), including its APIs or automation interfaces.
  • Strong Python software engineering skills beyond scripting: packaging, typing, automated testing, Git, code review, and CI/CD. OpenDSS experience is a plus.
  • A track record of building tools that other people use: libraries, applications, or open-source projects with real users.
  • Experience applying numerical methods and optimization (e.g., Pyomo, JuMP, Gurobi, HiGHS) to power systems problems.
  • Experience working with large data sets (time-series, AMI, SCADA) using tools such as pandas/Polars, SQL, or Parquet.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, particularly with respect to explaining complex technical matters.
  • Proven team player skills with ability to build and maintain internal and external relationships.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies (e.g., Scrum).

Beneficial Experience:

  • Proficiency in a compiled or high-performance language such as Rust, C++, Julia, or Java.
  • Contributions to open-source power systems tools (e.g., OpenDSS/AltDSS, DiTTo, GridLAB-D, PowerModelsDistribution, pandapower).
  • Experience with cloud-native development, containers, and distributed or high-performance computing (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with DER integration topics such as hosting capacity, IEEE 1547, DERMS, flexible interconnection, non-wires alternatives, and electrification load forecasting.
  • Breadth across transmission, controls, or T&D co-simulation.
  • Familiarity with GIS tools (preferably Esri) and utility network data models.
  • Experience leveraging machine learning and AI tools responsibly to improve engineering quality and productivity.
  • Publications or participation in IEEE PES or similar industry working groups.

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

How we support you:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • MyShare Employee Ownership Program
  • Work with industry leaders
  • 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1)

Location: This position is open to remote for highly qualified candidates

Travel: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less)

About the Role

Every closed-won deal starts as a signal. Your job is to make sure none of them get lost.

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation Operations, you'll be the strategic business partner to Abnormal's Revenue Marketing and Digital Marketing leaders, and the person who connects marketing activity to revenue outcomes. Reporting to Ted Noble, VP of GTM Operations, you'll translate ARR and pipeline targets into operational demand generation strategies and execution roadmaps, then ensure we are exceeding our plan for full funnel from MQL to Closed Won. When conversion stalls, a handoff breaks, or a stage gets stuck, you'll find out why and fix it. This is a role for someone who is energized by funnel math, cross-functional alignment, and turning messy data into clear decisions, and who wants to help make Abnormal the #1 AI-native company.

The targets are ambitious because the momentum is real. Abnormal closed FY26 at roughly $380M in ARR, growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. As we expand from email security into the Abnormal Behavioral AI platform, the funnel gets more complex: more products, more buying committees, and more paths from first touch to closed-won. Hitting our growth goals depends on a demand engine that is measured clearly, managed tightly, and improved every quarter. You'll build and run that engine.

What You Will Do

  • Turn targets into plans. Translate ARR and pipeline targets into operational demand generation strategies, funnel models, and execution roadmaps, working back from revenue goals to the volume, conversion, and velocity needed at every stage.
  • Be the strategic partner to marketing leadership. Serve as the operational business partner to the leaders of Revenue Marketing and Digital Marketing, helping them plan, prioritize, and invest where the funnel says it will matter most.
  • Own the lead lifecycle model. Establish and refine the end-to-end lead lifecycle model (MQL, GP, SAL, QP, POV, Closed Won), conversion benchmarks, and Sales-Marketing Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Run the funnel reviews. Lead regular pipeline velocity and campaign performance reviews with Sales, Business Development (BDR/SDR), and Marketing executives to identify funnel bottlenecks and optimize conversion paths.
  • Solve bottlenecks from MQL to Closed Won. Diagnose where and why pipeline stalls, whether in lead quality, speed-to-lead, handoffs, stage progression, or win rates, and drive the fixes with the teams that own them.
  • Hold the line on SLAs. Monitor SLA adherence and stage latency across Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams, and make performance visible so accountability is shared and gaps get closed quickly.
  • Connect programs to pipeline. Partner with Marketing Operations and Revenue Analytics to measure campaign and channel performance against pipeline and revenue, so investment decisions are grounded in real outcomes.
  • Plan for a multi-product funnel. Help evolve the funnel model, targeting, and account-based planning as we sell more products into more buying committees across the platform.
  • Use AI to see problems sooner. Bring an AI-first mindset to funnel monitoring, using automation and AI-driven insights to surface early warning signs and recommended actions before they become missed quarters.
  • Partner across GTM. Work closely with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Systems & Analytics, Sales, and SDR leadership so systems, definitions, and reporting stay aligned across the funnel.

Must Haves

  • 7+ years of experience in demand generation operations, marketing operations, revenue operations, or a related analytical GTM role at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
  • Proven track record translating revenue and pipeline targets into demand generation plans and funnel models.
  • Deep experience designing and managing lead lifecycle models, stage definitions, conversion benchmarks, and Sales-Marketing SLAs.
  • Experience leading pipeline and campaign performance reviews with senior Sales and Marketing leaders, and driving action from the findings.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with funnel, attribution, and pipeline data across Salesforce, marketing automation, and BI tools.
  • Working knowledge of lead scoring, routing, and marketing attribution, and how they affect funnel performance.
  • Exceptional cross-functional communication skills, with the credibility to align Marketing, SDR, and Sales leaders around shared definitions and goals.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with tools in our ecosystem, such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Snowflake, and Sigma.
  • Experience supporting account-based marketing and multi-product or platform GTM motions.
  • Background in cybersecurity or another technical, enterprise-focused category.

Job Title: Director, IT Audit

Department: Internal Audit

Reports to: Chief Audit Officer

About this role

The Director, IT Audit provides strategic leadership for the organization’s technology audit function. This executive role oversees comprehensive risk assessments, evaluates IT governance and cybersecurity controls, ensures strict regulatory compliance, and advises executive leadership and the Audit Committee on mitigating technology risks across enterprise infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments.

Responsibilities

  • Audit Strategy & Planning: Develop and execute an annual, risk-based IT audit plan aligned with corporate business objectives, regulatory requirements, and emerging technology trends.
  • Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Assessment: Direct complex audits covering network security, cloud architecture (Google/AWS), identity and access management (IAM), data privacy, and business continuity/disaster recovery.
  • Governance & Compliance Frameworks: Evaluate alignment and compliance with industry frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT, SOC 2, and applicable data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, NDPR).
  • Executive Leadership & Governance: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of IT auditors and technical specialists. Foster continuous professional development and technical proficiency.
  • Reporting & Stakeholder Management: Present audit findings, comprehensive risk evaluations, and practical remediation plans directly to the Chief Audit Officer and Senior Executive Management.
  • Continuous Monitoring & Analytics: Drive innovation by embedding automated audit techniques, data analytics, and continuous controls monitoring (CCM) into the overall audit lifecycle to enhance efficiency.

Experience & Background

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in IT auditing, technology risk management, or cybersecurity, including 4+ years in a senior leadership/management role.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) required. Additional credentials such as CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or CIA are highly desirable.
  • Deep technical understanding of cloud environments (Google & AWS), network infrastructure, database security, API, application controls, and IT General Controls (ITGCs).

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, executive presence, oral and written communication, strategic problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Strong proficiency in risk assessment prowess and deep thinking.
  • Advanced predictive & prescriptive data analytics skills.
  • Self-driven capacity, agility, customer obsession, professional skepticism, and urgency.

What success looks like in this role

  • Establishment of a robust, proactive, risk-based IT audit strategy that protects enterprise assets and cloud infrastructure.
  • High-performing, technically proficient IT audit team delivering clear, high-impact evaluations and actionable remediation plans.
  • Continuous integration of automated audit controls, analytics, and full compliance with industry regulatory standards and frameworks.

Why join us

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
  • Fully remote work culture and support for professional development

Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer

Remote | East Coast Hours | Up to 10% Travel | Full Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking an experienced Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer to support the development, verification, and certification of advanced aviation navigation systems.

This position will support functional, system, performance, and hardware/software integration testing for safety critical avionics applications. The selected engineer will develop and execute test cases, test scripts, procedures, and verification activities designed to evaluate system performance against defined technical and certification requirements.

The role requires deep experience with DO-178C software verification and certification, avionics software and hardware testing, requirements-based verification, and safety critical aviation systems. The successful candidate must be capable of independently analyzing requirements, developing verification approaches, executing tests, evaluating results, documenting anomalies, and producing high-quality verification evidence.

This position also requires hands on experience with SCADE, strong Java development experience, and familiarity with avionics certification and aircraft safety analysis.

The ideal candidate is an experienced verification engineer who combines strong software development knowledge with rigorous testing discipline, exceptional attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of safety critical aviation software development and certification.

Key Responsibilities

Software Verification & Testing

  • Develop, review, and execute software and system test cases, test scripts, and test procedures.
  • Perform requirements-based verification of safety critical avionics software.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and performance testing.
  • Verify software behavior against system and software requirements.
  • Analyze test results and identify, document, and investigate anomalies.
  • Perform regression testing following software or requirements changes.
  • Support software verification activities throughout the avionics development lifecycle.
  • Ensure test artifacts are complete, traceable, repeatable, and suitable for certification evidence.

Avionics Hardware & Software Integration

  • Perform software testing on avionics hardware platforms and integrated hardware/software environments.
  • Support hardware/software integration testing associated with navigation avionics.
  • Evaluate system behavior under normal, abnormal, and boundary conditions.
  • Troubleshoot software, hardware, interface, and integration issues.
  • Support simulation, bench testing, and hardware in the loop testing environments when applicable.
  • Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to isolate and resolve technical issues.

DO-178C Certification & Compliance

  • Perform verification activities in accordance with DO-178C objectives.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of verification evidence required for avionics certification.
  • Ensure traceability between system requirements, software requirements, test procedures, test results, and identified anomalies.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, test reviews, peer reviews, and certification related activities.
  • Support development and review of verification documentation and certification artifacts.
  • Assist with identifying and resolving verification gaps or compliance issues.

Requirements Analysis & Traceability

  • Review system and software requirements for clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability.
  • Develop test cases and procedures directly from approved requirements.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements and verification artifacts.

About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Role:

Fullscript is how thousands of healthcare providers deliver better care to their patients, and paid digital is one of our biggest growth levers. As Senior Digital Marketing Specialist, you’ll oversee paid strategy across search, social, and programmatic, manage a large budget, and have a dedicated experimentation budget to find the channels and tactics that will drive our next stage of growth. You’ll work with a high-performing agency and a small in-house team, with the autonomy to shape how Fullscript reaches new providers online.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven and strategic marketing leader who can balance hands-on campaign management with long-term strategic vision. You will shape Fullscript’s paid digital approach, mentor a growing team, and continuously evolve how Fullscript connects with healthcare providers online.

What You’ll Do:

  • Paid Digital Strategy: Includes Paid Search, including Google’s AI-driven formats (PMax, AI Max) and automated bidding, with the judgment to know when to lean into automation and when to take back control. Social, and Programmatic.Strategically drive planning, executing, and optimizing paid campaigns across platforms, focusing on customer acquisition. Ensure cohesive strategy across all channels.

  • Campaign Management: While hands-on execution is managed by our agency, this role will be expected to optimize, and troubleshoot digital campaigns across the marketing funnel. Leverage market-leading DSPs, Meta, Google Ads, and Microsoft Ads to achieve Fullscript’s growth goals.

  • Test & Learn: Own a dedicated experimentation budget to pilot new channels, tactics, and formats, such as healthcare networks, CTV, LinkedIn, or emerging AI-driven ad products. Design tests with clear hypotheses and success criteria, and make the call on what scales and what gets cut.

  • Data Analysis & Insights: Own how we measure paid performance, using incrementality testing, first-party data, and offline conversion tracking to optimize toward qualified providers and revenue, not just leads. Navigate signal loss and healthcare advertising restrictions, and turn large data sets into clear recommendations that drive efficiency and ROI.

  • Team Collaboration & Leadership: Work closely with internal teams including marketing, creative, and data, while also managing external partners. Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, ensuring the effective execution of campaigns.

  • Client & Partner Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with external partners, and cross functional stakeholders. Collaborate on strategy and planning for campaigns as part of Fullscript’s broader marketing mix.

  • Process Improvement: Actively contribute to the development and enhancement of Fullscript’s paid digital capabilities, using AI tools and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, and creative iteration. Identify and implement process improvements to automate and streamline workflow to ensure efficient high-quality campaign delivery.

  • Budget Management: Oversee your portion of the paid digital budget management, including spend delivery, invoicing, investment, and forecast tracking. Help drive profitability within the department while ensuring campaign efficiency and performance.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years experience in paid digital campaign management, with hands-on experience using Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, DSPs, and other ad-serving platforms.

  • Experience in managing $5 million+ in annual paid budgets.

  • Strong knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, focused on the US and Canadian Healthcare market, with an emphasis on paid search, paid social, programmatic display, and their roles in customer engagement.

  • A sharp eye for performance copy, with experience writing and testing ad messaging that drives clicks and conversions.

  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets and Slides to be able to turn complex performance data into a clear story and recommendations for leadership.

  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to work with large data sets and derive actionable insights.

  • Detail-oriented with a high degree of numeracy and literacy to manage complex campaigns and deliver results.

  • Strong communication skills, able to work cross-functionally, and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Experience managing commercial aspects of digital campaigns, including budgeting, invoicing, and margin management.

    • Bonus Points:

  • Healthcare B2B and B2C experience.

  • Experience and frameworks to apply with A/B testing to refine campaigns and improve results.

  • Familiarity with performance tracking tools like Google Analytics and Looker Studio to evaluate paid digital program performance.

  • Experience developing and executing marketing strategies for a multi-product platform serving both SMB and Enterprise customers

Compensation Range:

    The salary range for this role is between $90 000 and $120 000 [CAD]. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

    Final base salary depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

    Additionally:

    ⬦ Flexible PTO & competitive pay – Because work-life balance matters.
    ⬦ RRSP/401k match – Invest in your future.

    ⬦ Fullscript discounts – Save on high-quality wellness products.
    ⬦ Continuous learning opportunities – Training budgets and company-wide initiatives.
    ⬦ Hybrid & remote work flexibility – Your office, your way.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager Cyber Security (m/w/d) – Aufbau Neukundengeschäft
jobs.excerpt: Deine MissionCyber Security entscheidet heute über die Zukunftsfähigkeit von Unternehmen.
jobs.description:
Deine Mission

Cyber Security entscheidet heute über die Zukunftsfähigkeit von Unternehmen. Als Sales Manager (m/w/d) für unsere Cyber-Security-Beratung erschließt du neue Kundenbeziehungen, vertiefst bestehende Partnerschaften und identifizierst konkrete Geschäftschancen für unsere Beratungsleistungen.

Deine Stärke ist es, Menschen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Vertrauen aufzubauen und gemeinsam mit unseren Solution Managern passgenaue Lösungsansätze zu entwickeln. Dein Ziel: echten Bedarf frühzeitig erkennen, qualifizierte Opportunities aufbauen und realistische Budgets verhandeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst aktiv neue Kundenbeziehungen im Offline-Vertrieb und baust unser Netzwerk systematisch aus.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Zielkunden und Ansprechpartner in den von uns definierten Märkten.
  • Du knüpfst neue Kontakte, organisierst Erstgespräche und führst überzeugende Ice-Breaker-Pitches durch.
  • Du qualifizierst potenzielle Leads hinsichtlich Bedarf, konkreten Herausforderungen, Entscheidungsstrukturen, Zeitplanung und Budget.
  • Du lieferst vorqualifizierte Business Opportunities an unser Management und unsere Solution Manager.
  • Du begleitest Kontakte kontinuierlich vom ersten Austausch bis zur konkreten Opportunity und stellst ein konsequentes Follow-up sicher.
  • Du nimmst an relevanten Fachveranstaltungen, Branchen-Events und Networking-Formaten teil.
  • Du analysierst Events im Vorfeld, identifizierst für uns relevante Kontakte und sprichst diese gezielt an.
  • Du entwickelst unseren bestehenden Sales-Prozess weiter und machst Vertriebsaktivitäten messbarer und effizienter.
  • Du arbeitest als Sparringspartner eng mit Marketing, Management und Solution Managern zusammen.
  • Du gibst Markt- und Kundenfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Vertriebs- und Beratungsangebots zurück.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gewinnung neuer Kunden und im Aufbau belastbarer Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Ein eigenes, für unser Geschäft relevantes Netzwerk sowie die Fähigkeit, dieses kontinuierlich auszubauen.
  • Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Ansprache und Vorqualifizierung potenzieller Kunden.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für den Markt des Security Consulting und die Abgrenzung zum Vertrieb von Security-Produkten.
  • Die Fähigkeit, Bedarf, Needs und Budgets potenzieller Kunden strukturiert zu erfassen und realistisch einzuschätzen.
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie Freude an persönlichen Kundenterminen, Networking und Events.
  • Ausgeprägte soziale Kompetenz und ein sicheres Gespür für unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner.
  • Die Fähigkeit, dich auf Menschen, Rollen, Branchen und Gesprächssituationen flexibel einzustellen.
  • Ein modernes, digitales und unternehmerisches Mindset.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Du musst nicht zu jedem Kunden bereits die fertige Lösung präsentieren. Deine Aufgabe ist es, Interesse zu wecken, relevante Gespräche zu eröffnen und echte Herausforderungen zu erkennen.

Wir suchen deshalb eine Persönlichkeit, die:

  • Einen überzeugenden Ice-Breaker-Pitch beherrscht
  • Nicht versucht, vorschnell eine dedizierte Solution zu verkaufen
  • Aufmerksam zuhört und die richtigen Fragen stellt
  • Vertrauen aufbaut, ohne aufdringlich zu wirken
  • Auch komplexe Cyber-Security-Themen verständlich vermitteln kann
  • Kontakte nicht nur sammelt, sondern nachhaltig entwickelt

Unser Vergütungsmodell

Wir bieten dir ein transparentes und leistungsorientiertes Vergütungsmodell:

  • 60.000 bis 70.000 € fixes Jahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation.
  • Ein variabler Vergütungsanteil von rund 40 % auf Basis klar definierter Vertriebsziele.
  • Bei Überperformance ist eine Gesamtzielerreichung von bis zu 150 % möglich.
  • Ein Firmenwagen wird gestellt.
  • Die Provision wird quartalsweise ausgezahlt.
  • Im ersten Quartal gleichen wir den noch nicht vorhandenen Provisionsanteil durch eine Aufstockung des Fixgehalts aus.

Warum du zu uns kommen solltest

  • Du baust einen wichtigen Vertriebsbereich in einem zukunftskritischen Markt aktiv mit auf.
  • Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum bei Kundenansprache, Netzwerkaufbau und Prozessentwicklung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Solution Managern, Marketing und Management zusammen.
  • Du verkaufst keine beliebigen Produkte, sondern hilfst Unternehmen, ihre Cyber Security strategisch und nachhaltig zu verbessern.
  • Deine Kontakte, Ideen und Erfolge werden sichtbar und wertgeschätzt.
  • Du profitierst von einem attraktiven Fixgehalt, einer leistungsorientierten Provision und einem Firmenwagen.

Bewirb dich bei uns

Du erkennst dich in dieser Rolle wieder und möchtest Cyber-Security-Consulting gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und einigen Sätzen zu deinen bisherigen Erfolgen im B2B-Vertrieb, deinem relevanten Netzwerk und deiner Motivation für den Bereich Cyber Security.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

With a focus on our Australia-based executive team, you’ll manage complex schedules, coordinate travel and events, support executive priorities, and act as a key point of contact for stakeholders across the business.

This role requires exceptional organisation, sound judgement, and the ability to anticipate needs before they arise. You'll be trusted with highly confidential information and play an important role in keeping our leadership team connected, informed, and operating efficiently.

This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving problems before they become problems, and can confidently manage competing priorities across multiple time zones. You'll work closely with senior leaders across the business (with a focus on supporting executives based in our Brisbane HQ) and gain unique exposure to the inner workings of a global technology company.

  • Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the confidence to engage with senior stakeholders.
  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Resourceful and solutions-focused, with a knack for finding answers and getting things done.

  • Strong judgement, integrity, and professionalism.
  • Confident learning and adopting new tools, systems, and technologies.
  • Flexible and responsive when business priorities shift or support is needed outside standard hours.

  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives
  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave

ABOUT ABNORMAL AI

Abnormal AI stops the attacks other tools miss by understanding the behavior of every identity inside an organization, not just matching known signatures. That approach started with email, where we protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500. It's the same behavioral AI, built over eight years, that now powers our new AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. We're launching new products faster than at any point in our history, and this role sits right at the center of that expansion.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite. One Specialist sits in each sales pod, working alongside the pod's Account Executives to bring deep sales and product expertise to AI Security conversations. This is a sales role, built for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. If you want to be at the center of one of the fastest-moving new product lines in cybersecurity, with the technical range to earn trust at every level of a customer's organization, this is that role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Carry a dedicated quota for the AI Security suite, separate from your pod's core quota.
  • Partner with Account Executives across your pod to identify, qualify, and advance AI Security opportunities within existing and prospective accounts.
  • Go deep on the technical substance of behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when customers need more than a standard pitch, credibly holding your own with security and platform teams.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, partnering closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Help build the playbook for how AI Security gets sold as this suite matures from early availability into GA. Much of this motion is still being defined, and you'll have real influence over how it takes shape.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly as products move from design partner to GA.

WHAT YOU'LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

Product

Description

AI Governance

Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.

AI Cloud Security

Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.

AI Employee Guardrails

Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.

AI Agent Security

Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.

AI Security Workbench

Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

AI security is coming up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust Abnormal's behavioral approach to solve it. Every security vendor is staking a claim in this space, but Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a proven track record protecting email for thousands of customers.

That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure Abnormal capitalizes on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means getting in early on a brand-new motion, working closely with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of Enterprise sales experience (3,000+ seat accounts), with a proven track record of winning new logos, expanding accounts, and displacing legacy competitors in competitive markets.
  • Genuine technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity. This suite and the motion for selling it are both still evolving, and much of the playbook will be built by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. This role depends on tight partnership with AEs, Sales Engineering, and product leadership rather than working in isolation.
  • Prior exposure to cybersecurity, AI/ML concepts, or cloud security.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution! The Algorithmic Model Optimization Team focuses on optimizing generative AI models such as large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and diffusion models for maximal inference efficiency using techniques ranging from quantization, speculative decoding, sparsity, distillation, pruning to neural architecture search, and automated deployment strategies.

Our work includes conducting applied research to improve model efficiency as well as developing an innovative open-source model optimization platform (NVIDIA Model Optimizer). Our software is used both internally across NVIDIA and externally by research and engineering teams alike developing best-in-class AI models.

We are seeking a GenAI Algorithms Intern to help optimize state-of-the-art generative AI models like LLMs, VLMs, multimodal and diffusion models. In this role, you will design, implement, and productionize model optimization algorithms for inference and deployment on NVIDIA’s latest hardware platforms. The focus is on ease of use, compute and memory efficiency, and achieving the best accuracy–performance tradeoffs through software–hardware co-design.

Your work will span multiple layers of the AI software stack—ranging from algorithm design to integration—within NVIDIA’s ecosystem (Model Optimizer, NeMo/Megatron, TensorRT-LLM) and open-source frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang). You may also dive deeper into GPU-level optimization, including custom kernel development with CUDA and Triton.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Help design and build modular, scalable model optimization software platforms that deliver exceptional user experiences while supporting diverse AI models and optimization techniques.
  • Explore, develop, and integrate innovative deep learning optimization algorithms (quantization, speculative decoding, sparsity, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search) into NVIDIA's AI software stack.
  • Deploy optimized models into leading open-source inference frameworks and contribute specialized APIs, model-level optimizations, and new features tailored to the latest NVIDIA hardware capabilities.
  • Collaborate with NVIDIA teams on model optimization solutions for customer use cases, aiming for optimal end-to-end workflows and balanced accuracy–performance trade-offs.
  • Conduct GPU kernel-level profiling to identify and capitalize on hardware and software optimization opportunities (e.g., efficient attention kernels, KV cache optimization, parallelism strategies).

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Applied Math, or a related field.
  • Strong deep learning background and hands-on experience with language models.
  • Solid foundation in algorithms and programming.
  • Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and modern ML frameworks/tools.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with model optimization and efficiency (e.g., quantization, distillation, pruning).
  • Contributions to PyTorch, JAX, vLLM, SGLang, or other machine learning training and inference frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning generative AI models on large-scale GPU clusters.
  • Knowledge of GPU architectures and compilation stacks, and the ability to analyze and debug end-to-end performance.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA’s deep learning SDKs (Model Optimizer, NeMo).

Increasingly known as “the AI computing company” and widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Are you creative, motivated, and love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you! Come, join our model optimization group, where you can help build real-time, cost-effective computing platforms driving our success in this exciting and rapidly-growing field.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Our internship pay is based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. For Poland: the annual range for our interns is 117,750 PLN - 204,100 PLN. (pro-rated for the duration of the internship).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance | Germany | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany or Sweden.

Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.

To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. We are a 100% remote company. We believe in high-velocity but sustainable expectations and timeframes, giving people the room to do great work.

The Opportunity:

You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.

This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
  • Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
  • Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements
  • Deploy security and compliance checks in an employee-enabling way (guardrails and paved roads) in their daily workflows and build pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and operational processes.
  • Respond to customer security issues, security alerts, and potential incidents

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience developing in a production environment with at least one programming language. We primarily use Go, TypeScript, and Python but most languages translate well. You will take a code screen and be expected to discuss programming principles such as algorithms, data structures, and optimization
  • Knowledge of using and securing containerized, cloud-native applications, ideally with Kubernetes. Experience with multiple cloud providers is a strong plus
  • Experience in automating security and compliance processes using tools, scripts, and frameworks while enabling developer and employee workflows
  • Strong interpersonal skills, as this position will require communication with peers, stakeholders, auditors, and customers
  • Understanding of industry-recognized security frameworks, standards, and certifications, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, or GDPR, and how to apply them without added operational burden. You can gain this by reading the standards documents and audit guidance
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Bonus Points For:

  • Working knowledge of Grafana Labs OSS projects and products. Experience in using observability tooling to solve security problems.
  • Experience working with OSS communities
  • Experience in using technical automations to prove infrastructure compliance
  • Experience securing large-scale distributed systems running in public clouds

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €97,034 - €116,441. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you’ll take the lead on the member-facing programs that introduce people to our life-changing care. Your top priority will be architecting the end-to-end service journey—from the moment a member is introduced to our offering through their complete onboarding. You will act as a strategic visionary in a fast-moving environment, mapping out complex enrollment flows and translating them into highly engaging experiences that inspire program adoption by clearly demonstrating the transformative benefits of our care.

Twin HQ is in Menlo Park, California, but this role is open to remote applicants in the US.

We are seeking a designer whose exceptional visual craft is matched only by their deep, rigorous service design thinking. You are a strategic systems-builder who brings order to ambiguity. You aren't just designing screens; you are designing holistic, deeply considered omnichannel experiences that balance premium, persuasive aesthetics with the logistical complexities of physical hardware and digital healthcare.

Responsibilities

  • Define Personas & Value Propositions: Identify and construct distinct user personas based on direct research insights. Uncover the specific barriers and core value propositions that resonate most powerfully with each persona, ensuring we speak directly to their unique needs.
  • Architect Persona-Driven Journeys: Take the lead on multiple programs by mapping out tailored end-to-end enrollment flows. Design targeted experiences centered around the established value propositions of your personas to create a seamless, persuasive transition from initial program discovery to active participation.
  • Drive Comprehensive Service Design: Look beyond isolated digital features to own the entire physical and digital ecosystem. Design interconnected touchpoints that guide members through tracking their health kit shipment, the physical unboxing experience, pairing their hardware sensors, and scheduling their initial virtual appointment with the Twin Health care team.
  • Craft Compelling, Premium Visuals: Produce immaculate websites, landing pages, and enrollment assets that excite members and clearly communicate our value. High visual polish is critical to building trust, and you must balance this premium consumer-facing aesthetic with rapid execution.
  • Navigate Cross-Functional Complexity: Operate effectively in high-velocity, ambiguous environments. Collaborate closely with marketing, hardware/logistics, and clinical operations to ensure the physical realities of unboxing and hardware setup align perfectly with the digital UX.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive a cohesive, user-first mindset across product, engineering, and client-facing teams. Clearly articulate your research-backed design rationale and align disparate groups around a shared vision for an unparalleled onboarding experience.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Service & Visual Design Mastery: 8+ years of UX/product design experience. Your portfolio must be a masterclass in both high-end visual polish (consumer-facing or marketing-led design) and complex, multi-touchpoint journey mapping, showcasing how you connect digital and physical interactions.
  • Research & Strategy Expertise: Proven experience conducting user research, defining actionable personas, and successfully translating those strategic insights into tailored, high-converting product flows.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience designing complex consumer enrollment flows, digital healthcare journeys, or premium e-commerce/unboxing experiences. You understand how to use design to drive adoption and build user habits from day one.
  • Omnichannel Agility: Deep expertise spanning responsive web and native mobile design patterns. You confidently navigate the constraints of different platforms and know how to bridge the gap between UI flows and real-world actions (like connecting Bluetooth sensors).
  • Systems & Logistics Literacy: Experience designing for hardware-software integrations or complex logistical workflows (e.g., shipping tracking, appointment routing) is a distinct advantage. You can communicate clearly with engineering regarding technical capabilities and data flows.
  • Communication: Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills. You can pitch a concept, defend a complex product decision, and write the persuasive, engaging UI copy needed to speak to different personas, drive enrollment, and reduce drop-off.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in design, service design, HCI, or a related field.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $190,000 - $210,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan
